generate.run.summary: Generate one package from a Definition
generate.run.description:
Returns one generated package without creating a Project.

Supports [idempotent retries](https://typeship.dev/docs/typeship-api/idempotency); keyed responses include generated files in the replay cache.

Anonymous and Free requests include the first 25 operations. Paid plans include all operations. Anonymous requests are rate limited by IP address. Check `limits` for omitted operations; an invalid API key returns `401`.

An anonymous URL request without source headers may return `claim.url`. Sign in through that link within seven days to save the recipe as a Project.

projects.create.description:
Creates a Project from a URL or GitHub Definition.

Free includes one saved Project, all selected Targets, and the first 25 operations per Target, with regeneration, history, delivery pull requests, and previews. Pro supports additional Projects and all operations. One-shot generation does not use a Project slot.

projects.retrieve.description: Returns the Project's settings and Definition ID. List its Targets separately to retrieve Target configuration and Deliveries.

projects.delete.description: A `502` response means the Project was not deleted because its release pull requests could not be retired.

projects.update.description:
Omitted fields keep their current values. A supplied config replaces the entire stored object; null or an empty object clears it.
Updates have no revision precondition. Concurrent updates preserve omitted fields, and the last saved update to a supplied field wins.

A `502` response means the Project was saved, but an obsolete release pull request could not be retired.

projects.retrieveDiagnostics.summary: Analyze a project's latest Definition Revision
projects.retrieveDiagnostics.description: Checks the latest Definition Revision after applying its saved patches. Each finding groups affected locations under a stable rule ID. A suggested patch is included only when the Definition provides enough information to determine the correction.

projects.refreshDiagnostics.summary: Refresh a project's Diagnostics from its configured source
projects.refreshDiagnostics.description: Fetches the configured source and returns updated Diagnostics. Creates a Definition Revision only when the content changes. Does not generate Targets or use a metered generation.

projects.remediateDiagnostics.description:
Applies reviewed patches from Diagnostics. For a repository source, opens or updates a source pull request. For a URL source, saves Definition patches.

Findings that need an API-owner decision return `422`. Read the finding's `authoring_brief` and update the source instead.

projects.retrieveIntegrationHealth.description: Checks repository access, Definition readability, source-approval labels, and required checks. Includes the latest webhook delivery so you can investigate missing updates.

projects.generate.summary: Generate targets and open pull requests
projects.generate.description:
Generates each active Target from the Project's source, saves the results, and attempts delivery to each configured destination.

If the package already matches a destination and no Draft is open, returns `pr_status: no_changes` without creating a commit, branch, or pull request. An existing Draft stays open. Automatic generation uses the same workflow.

definitions.update.description:
Resolves the source documents before saving the update and records a new Definition Revision when the source changes.
Omitted fields remain unchanged; supplied objects and arrays replace the whole field.
No revision parameter or If-Match header is required. If the Definition or its Project
configuration changes during validation, returns 409 definition_changed without saving
the rejected update. Retrieve the current Definition and Project, reconcile your changes,
and submit a new request with a new Idempotency-Key if using one.

targets.create.description: Creates a Target with its own configuration, Deliveries, and release history. Multiple Targets can use the same generator.

targets.delete.description: Deletes a Target with no Generation history, release history, or active Draft. Disable a Target instead if it has any of these.

targets.update.summary: Update a Target, its Deliveries, or its next reviewed version
targets.update.description:
Omitted fields keep their current values. Supplied config, checks, and deliveries replace their complete stored values.
Updates have no revision precondition. Concurrent updates preserve omitted fields, and the last saved update to a supplied field wins.
Send proposed_version by itself; use the Draft endpoint for a version selection with an optional revision precondition.

A `502` response means the selected version was saved, but regeneration failed.

targets.listReleases.summary: List immutable releases for a Target

targets.retrieveDraft.summary: Retrieve a Target's rolling Draft release
targets.retrieveDraft.description: Returns Current's version, the proposed Draft version, readiness, and commit. Pass `revision` as `expected_revision` when updating the Draft to avoid changing a newer candidate.

targets.updateDraft.summary: Select an exact Draft version or return to automatic versioning
targets.updateDraft.description:
Checks your version choice against the required version bump, then regenerates the existing Draft pull request.

Send the last read revision as expected_revision to reject an intervening change with 409 stale_release_revision before saving or regenerating.
The precondition is optional; omitting it applies the selection to the current Draft. Version is required; null restores automatic selection.

A `502` response means the selected version was saved, but regeneration failed.

targets.retrieveCustomizations.summary: Inspect preserved custom code for a Target Draft
targets.retrieveCustomizations.description: Returns preserved changes, conflicts, reused resolutions, and check results for the Draft. Includes the input and package identifiers needed to compare attempts. Does not include file contents.

targets.resetCustomizations.summary: Resolve or reset custom code on the rolling Draft
targets.resetCustomizations.description:
Keeps the current or generated side of selected conflicts, or resets all customizations. Reruns integration and checks on the same Draft. Supply the expected head revision to prevent a stale choice from changing a newer Draft.

A `502` response means regeneration failed after the reset commit.

targets.adoptRelease.summary: Adopt a verified existing package as Current
targets.adoptRelease.description: Checks the repository tag, package metadata, and registry artifact, then records the package as an Imported Current release. Opens the first Typeship Draft at the next major version; review it to establish the baseline for preserving existing code.

targets.republishRelease.summary: Retry publication of an exact Target release
targets.republishRelease.description:
Retries publication of the specified release through its repository workflow. Uses that release's version and accepted commit, even if a newer Draft or release exists.

A `502` response means the repository publication workflow could not be dispatched.

generations.retrieve.description: Returns the Generation result. Successful results include files, or a file index when the package is too large to inline.

generations.retrieveFile.summary: Fetch one file from a generation
generations.retrieveFile.description: Returns one file's raw content. Use a path from `files_index` when the Generation reports `files_omitted: true`.

definitionRevisions.list.description: Lists the Definition's revisions, newest first. Source content is not included; retrieve the revision content or individual documents separately.

definitionRevisions.retrieve.description: Returns metadata for a saved Definition Revision. Retrieve its resolved content or individual source documents separately.

definitionRevisions.retrieveContent.summary: Retrieve a Definition Revision's canonical content
definitionRevisions.retrieveContent.description: Returns the saved, resolved content for this revision. Save it locally or compare it with another revision.

definitionRevisions.retrieveDocumentCont.summary: Retrieve one source document from a Definition Revision

account.retrieve.summary: The account behind the presented credentials
account.retrieve.description: Returns the account associated with your credential. The Typeship CLI uses this endpoint for `whoami`.

apiKeys.list.description: Lists key metadata and the last four characters of each key. Full keys are not returned. Create keys in the Console.

apiKeys.revoke.description:
Revokes a key. Repeating the request returns the same result.

With OAuth, members can revoke their own keys; organization admins can revoke any key. Organization API keys can revoke any key in their account.
